mapper.select: WITH callback_input AS ( SELECT raw.ordinal, DECODE(raw."idHex", 'hex') AS callback_id, DECODE(raw."orderIdHex", 'hex') AS order_id, raw."providerTradeNo" AS provider_trade_no, raw."tradeStatus" AS trade_status, raw."paidAmountYuan" AS paid_amount_yuan, raw."paidAt" AS paid_at, raw."receivedAt" AS received_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{callbacksJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( ordinal INTEGER, "idHex" TEXT, "orderIdHex" TEXT, "providerTradeNo" TEXT, "tradeStatus" TEXT, "paidAmountYuan" NUMERIC, "paidAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "receivedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO membership_payment_callback ( id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_amount_yuan, paid_at, received_at ) SELECT callback_id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_amount_yuan, paid_at, received_at FROM callback_input ORDER BY ordinal ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_at, resolution, resolved_at ), resolved AS ( SELECT callback_input.ordinal, callback_input.callback_id, callback_input.order_id AS requested_order_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_order_id.id, stored_by_order_id.id, inserted_by_provider_trade_no.id, stored_by_provider_trade_no.id, inserted_by_callback_id.id, stored_by_callback_id.id ) AS persisted_callback_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_order_id.order_id, stored_by_order_id.order_id, inserted_by_provider_trade_no.order_id, stored_by_provider_trade_no.order_id, inserted_by_callback_id.order_id, stored_by_callback_id.order_id ) AS persisted_order_id, callback_input.provider_trade_no, callback_input.trade_status, COALESCE( inserted_by_order_id.resolution, stored_by_order_id.resolution, inserted_by_provider_trade_no.resolution, stored_by_provider_trade_no.resolution, inserted_by_callback_id.resolution, stored_by_callback_id.resolution ) AS resolution, inserted_by_callback_id.id AS inserted_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_order_id.id, stored_by_order_id.id ) AS order_fact_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_order_id.provider_trade_no, stored_by_order_id.provider_trade_no ) AS order_fact_provider_trade_no, COALESCE( inserted_by_provider_trade_no.id, stored_by_provider_trade_no.id ) AS provider_fact_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_provider_trade_no.order_id, stored_by_provider_trade_no.order_id ) AS provider_fact_order_id, COALESCE( inserted_by_callback_id.id, stored_by_callback_id.id ) AS id_fact_id FROM callback_input LEFT JOIN inserted inserted_by_callback_id ON inserted_by_callback_id.id = callback_input.callback_id LEFT JOIN inserted inserted_by_order_id ON inserted_by_order_id.order_id = callback_input.order_id LEFT JOIN inserted inserted_by_provider_trade_no ON inserted_by_provider_trade_no.provider_trade_no = callback_input.provider_trade_no LEFT JOIN membership_payment_callback stored_by_callback_id ON stored_by_callback_id.id = callback_input.callback_id LEFT JOIN membership_payment_callback stored_by_order_id ON stored_by_order_id.order_id = callback_input.order_id LEFT JOIN membership_payment_callback stored_by_provider_trade_no ON stored_by_provider_trade_no.provider_trade_no = callback_input.provider_trade_no ) SELECT resolved.ordinal, resolved.callback_id, resolved.requested_order_id, resolved.persisted_order_id, resolved.persisted_callback_id, resolved.provider_trade_no, resolved.trade_status, resolved.resolution, persisted_order.entitlement_resolution AS order_entitlement_resolution, CASE WHEN resolved.inserted_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'INSERTED' WHEN resolved.order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.order_fact_id <> resolved.provider_fact_id THEN 'IDENTITY_CONFLICT' WHEN resolved.order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.order_fact_provider_trade_no <> resolved.provider_trade_no THEN 'ORDER_DUPLICATE' WHEN resolved.provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.provider_fact_order_id <> resolved.requested_order_id THEN 'PROVIDER_TRADE_REUSED' WHEN resolved.id_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.persisted_order_id <> resolved.requested_order_id THEN 'CALLBACK_ID_REUSED' ELSE 'DUPLICATE' END AS outcome, resolved.inserted_id IS NOT NULL AS inserted, resolved.inserted_id IS NULL AND resolved.order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT ( resolved.provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.order_fact_id <> resolved.provider_fact_id ) AS duplicate, resolved.persisted_callback_id = resolved.callback_id AS same_callback, ( resolved.provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.provider_fact_order_id <> resolved.requested_order_id ) OR ( resolved.id_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND resolved.persisted_order_id <> resolved.requested_order_id ) AS order_mismatch FROM resolved LEFT JOIN membership_order AS persisted_order ON persisted_order.id = resolved.persisted_order_id ORDER BY resolved.ordinal

WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS callback_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS requested(requested_value) ) SELECT membership_payment_callback.id, membership_payment_callback.order_id, membership_payment_callback.provider_trade_no, membership_payment_callback.paid_amount_yuan, membership_payment_callback.trade_status, membership_payment_callback.paid_at, membership_payment_callback.received_at, membership_payment_callback.resolution, membership_payment_callback.resolved_at FROM membership_payment_callback JOIN requested ON requested.callback_id = membership_payment_callback.id ORDER BY membership_payment_callback.id FOR UPDATE OF membership_payment_callback

WITH requested AS ( SELECT DISTINCT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS callback_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{idsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS requested(requested_value) ) SELECT membership_payment_callback.id AS callback_id, membership_payment_callback.order_id, membership_payment_callback.provider_trade_no, membership_payment_callback.paid_amount_yuan, membership_payment_callback.resolution AS callback_resolution, membership_order.status AS order_status, membership_order.entitlement_resolution AS order_entitlement_resolution, membership_order.provider_trade_no AS order_provider_trade_no FROM requested INNER JOIN membership_payment_callback ON membership_payment_callback.id = requested.callback_id INNER JOIN membership_order ON membership_order.id = membership_payment_callback.order_id ORDER BY membership_payment_callback.id

SELECT MD5(COALESCE( STRING_AGG( ENCODE(membership_payment_callback.order_id, 'hex'), '' ORDER BY membership_payment_callback.order_id), '')) FROM membership_payment_callback INNER JOIN membership_order ON membership_order.id = membership_payment_callback.order_id WHERE membership_order.login_identity_id >= #{startInclusive,jdbcType=BIGINT} AND membership_order.login_identity_id < #{endExclusive,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.delete: WITH requested AS ( SELECT DECODE(requested_value, 'hex') AS order_id FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CAST(#{orderIdsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS requested(requested_value) ) DELETE FROM membership_payment_callback USING requested WHERE membership_payment_callback.order_id = requested.order_id
mapper.update: WITH raw_resolutions AS ( SELECT DECODE(raw."callbackIdHex", 'hex') AS callback_id, raw.resolution, raw."resolvedAt" AS resolved_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{resolutionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "callbackIdHex" TEXT, resolution TEXT, "resolvedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), resolutions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (callback_id) callback_id, resolution, resolved_at FROM raw_resolutions ORDER BY callback_id ) UPDATE membership_payment_callback SET resolution = COALESCE( membership_payment_callback.resolution, resolutions.resolution), resolved_at = COALESCE( membership_payment_callback.resolved_at, resolutions.resolved_at) FROM resolutions WHERE membership_payment_callback.id = resolutions.callback_id AND ( membership_payment_callback.resolution IS NULL OR membership_payment_callback.resolution = resolutions.resolution )
